Class LoginController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.GUI.SceneController
it.polimi.ingsw.view.GUI.LoginController
public class LoginController extends SceneController
Controller class for the Login scene in the GUI.

This class handles user credentials input (nickname validation and color selection), dynamic UI component styling based on game enumerations, hovering effects, and dispatching the login event to the underlying network architecture.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the controller automatically after its FXML elements have been fully loaded.

      This method populates the colorComboBox with values from the Color enum, hides the errorLabel, and applies custom item styling rules to both the dropdown list cells and the main selection cell. It also registers inline hover event listeners on the loginButton to inject dynamic linear gradient transitions via inline CSS styles.

    • showErrorMessage

      public void showErrorMessage(String msg)
      Displays a customized error string message on the UI's error label block.

      Since this message may originate from background network listening threads, the updates are safely wrapped and scheduled inside JavaFX's application UI rendering thread via Platform.runLater(Runnable).

      Overrides:
      showErrorMessage in class SceneController
      Parameters:
      msg - the validation error or exception descriptive message to show
